required: x-www-form-urlencoded single URL and newline list
owned binary HTTP response streams preserving headers
authenticated WebSocket binary uploads plus control/progress JSON
VM event subscriptions rather than task polling
io.response_ownership: Architectural policy: owned disposable response lease for HTTP file download; never return stream from already disposed HttpResponseMessage. Caller owns source stream unless explicitly configured; WS transfer/session disposal specified by client API. These are client rules, not server guarantees.
io.path_policy: Dedicated opaque Base64 path value preserves exact original bytes and URI-escapes once. No NFC/NFD normalization. Separate clear filenames and task output strings from encoded request paths.

concurrency.filesystem: One active FsTask according queued state; API may enqueue. Cancel/delete does not rollback.
concurrency.upload: One per-socket file transfer; reuse socket sequentially, pipeline chunks and concurrently receive progress; finalize/cancel acknowledge completion. Socket close leaves partial data, cancel deletes it. Chunk/window limits not documented.
concurrency.vm: USB single VM ownership; source says events instead of VM status/disk-task polling; stopped/running preconditions explicit.
concurrency.retry: No replay of mutations, including semantically destructive GET where applicable; architecture policy independent of HTTP method idempotence.
